title: Диалог о привлечении рабочих из Афганистана в РФ затормозился
summary: Переговоры о привлечении рабочей силы из Афганистана в Россию зашли в тупик, стороны до сих пор не приступили к детальному рассмотрению этой инициативы, сообщает в среду газета "Известия" со ссылкой на спецпредставителя президента РФ по Афганистану Замира Кабулова."Москва и Кабул обсуждают возможность привлечения афганских граждан на работу в РФ, однако диалог, похоже, забуксовал.

title: Zelensky Offers Energy Truce as Trump Signals Support for Patriot Production in Ukraine
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky met with US President Donald Trump during the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York. Ukraine offered a reciprocal energy ceasefire should Russia halt attacks on its power grid, while Trump signaled openness to licensing Patriot interceptor production in Ukraine.

title: Zelensky Condemns Delistings of Russian Oligarchs in Western Sanctions
summary: During his meeting with European Commission President Ursula Von der Leyen, President Volodymyr Zelensky said proposals to remove Russian oligarchs from EU sanction lists are “suicidal and counterproductive,” linking the warning to Russia’s continued missile and drone barrage on Ukraine nationwide. The talks also centered on sustaining Ukraine’s budget and defense needs through 2027.

title: Erdoğan Backs Peace Upholding Ukraine’s Territorial Integrity
summary: During the opening of the high-level debates of the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) on Tuesday, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan called on Russia’s full-scale invasion to end, with Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity preserved. His statement came as Turkey remains Russia’s third-largest fossil fuel buyer.

title: EU to Extend Russia Sanctions After Latvia Drops Opposition to Oligarch Delistings
summary: Latvia has backed down from opposing the delisting of two Russian oligarchs from EU sanctions, a decision pushed by France and Slovakia, ultimately paving the way for the extension of the EU’s sanctions against Russia hours before they are set to expire.

title: Putin Plans to Visit APEC Summit, May Skip Trump’s G20
summary: Vladimir Putin plans to attend the APEC summit hosted by Xi Jinping in China but is likely to skip Donald Trump’s G20 gathering in Florida, Bloomberg reported on Monday. His expected absence would also eliminate a possible venue for direct talks with Volodymyr Zelensky.

title: Latvia Blocks EU Bid to Lift Oligarch Sanctions
summary: Latvia blocked an EU compromise that would lift sanctions on Russian-linked billionaires Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman while renewing restrictions on roughly 3,000 other individuals and entities for three years. The sanctions require unanimous approval from all 27 EU members and are due to expire at midnight on Tuesday, unless an agreement is reached.

title: France to Strengthen Ukraine’s Air Defense With Radars, Interceptors
summary: France will supply Ukraine with radars and interceptor missiles as Kyiv faces intensified threats to its energy system ahead of winter. Macron’s announcement came after talks with Zelensky in New York and follows discussions with Trump on air defense, an energy-strike moratorium and possible peace negotiations.

title: Zelensky, Macron Discuss Energy Moratorium Ahead of Trump Meeting
summary: Zelensky met Macron in New York as Kyiv pushes for stronger air defense and reciprocal de-escalation ahead of talks with Trump.

title: Macron, Trump Discuss Interceptors for Ukraine and Energy Truce
summary: Macron pressed Trump for faster missile interceptors for Ukraine and discussed a possible reciprocal moratorium on Russian and Ukrainian energy strikes.

title: EU Extends Russia Sanctions for 3 Years, Delists 2 Oligarchs
summary: While EU ambassadors have finally agreed to extend sanctions on nearly 3,000 Russian individuals and entities after several failed attempts, the new sanctions will not include the previously disputed oligarchs, Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman. The decision has raised frustration among member states, while Kyiv condemned the move as unacceptable.

title: EU Threatens Sanctions Over Russia’s Sham Elections in Occupied Ukraine
summary: The EU condemned Russia’s parliamentary elections in occupied parts of Ukraine as a violation of international law and pledged sanctions against those involved in staging the vote.

title: EU Fails to Agree on Putin Sanctions Renewal
summary: EU ambassadors again failed to agree on extending individual sanctions against nearly 3,000 people and entities linked to Russia’s aggression against Ukraine. The restrictions covering Vladimir Putin and other senior Russian officials are due to expire on Tuesday, unless all 27 member states approve their renewal.

title: Kremlin Says No Progress in Ukraine Peace Talks
summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said there had been no progress in negotiations to end Russia’s war against Ukraine, but Moscow hoped trilateral talks involving the US would resume. His comments came as President Volodymyr Zelensky and US President Trump prepare to meet in New York.

title: Zelensky, Trump Agree to Meet in New York as Ukraine-US Peace Efforts Gain ‘Momentum’
summary: Zelensky and Trump agreed to meet in New York, as per the Ukrainian president. He described the talks as important and said the sides were discussing de-escalation, security, and humanitarian issues.
